# INXSocial

> INXSocial is an all-in-one browser-based social media management platform operated by INAXX LTD. It combines connected social accounts, post creation, single and bulk scheduling, a visual content calendar, media management, analytics and AI-assisted content creation in one workspace.

Canonical website: https://www.inxsocial.co.uk/

## Supported social networks
INXSocial currently supports customer social-account connections for:
- Facebook
- Instagram
- LinkedIn
- TikTok
- YouTube
- Pinterest
- Threads
- Bluesky
- X / Twitter

Available destination types, publishing formats, feed data and analytics metrics vary by network permissions and account type. Google Business is not currently supplied by the active publishing gateway and should not be described as supported.

## Product scope
INXSocial is one connected social media management workspace rather than a collection of separate public microsites. The public website describes the product from the canonical home page, while authenticated product functionality lives inside the INXSocial application.

Core workflows include:
- Connected account management
- Post creation and preview
- Single-post scheduling
- Bulk Scheduler
- Content Calendar
- Media Library
- Analytics
- AI caption assistance
- AI Content Studio

## AI Content Studio
Current creation workflows include:
- Image Post
- Carousel Post
- Short Video / Reel
- UGC Ad Post

Short Video / Reel can use AI-generated video or Stock Video Creator. AI Video Clipping is an upcoming feature.

## Analytics
- Content Performance by Publish Date shows current available metrics for posts published in the selected period.
- Live Performance Trend separately shows measured snapshot-to-snapshot changes after INXSocial begins tracking.
- Analytics can compare up to three selected connected account sources.
- Metric coverage varies by network and granted permissions.

## Current commercial plans
- Trial: £0 for 7 days, up to 2 connected accounts, up to 50 destination publications during the trial, full workflow and 20 AI credits.
- Creator: £18.99/month, up to 5 connected accounts and 150 AI credits/month.
- Pro: £34.99/month, up to 12 connected accounts, 500 AI credits/month and Priority support.
- Business: £59.99/month, up to 25 connected accounts, 1,200 AI credits/month and Priority support.
- Agency: £99.99/month, up to 50 connected accounts, 2,500 AI credits/month and Priority+ support.

All current plans include scheduling, Bulk Scheduler, Full Analytics, AI caption assistance and AI Content Studio. Paid plans are unlimited at the INXSocial publishing-product layer; external network permissions, formats and provider limits still apply.

## Company
INXSocial is operated by INAXX LTD in the United Kingdom.
